import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
sleep_health = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Explore the data
print(sleep_health.head())

# Create a violin plot to show the distribution of sleep duration
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.violinplot(x='Gender', y='Sleep Duration', data=sleep_health)
plt.title('Distribution of Sleep Duration by Gender')
plt.xlabel('Gender')
plt.ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
plt.show()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a bar chart to show the distribution of quality of sleep
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.countplot(x='Quality of Sleep', hue='Gender', data=sleep_health)
plt.title('Distribution of Quality of Sleep by Gender')
plt.xlabel('Quality of Sleep')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Gender')
plt.show()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output2.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a scatter plot to show the relationship between heart rate and daily steps
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.scatterplot(x='Daily Steps', y='Heart Rate', hue='Gender', data=sleep_health)
plt.title('Relationship between Daily Steps and Heart Rate')
plt.xlabel('Daily Steps')
plt.ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)')
plt.legend(title='Gender')
plt.show()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output3.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
